rationale: The entry premise was buyers absorbing supply above the base at $8.89-8.91, but since entry the price has broken below that base to $8.86-8.88, printed zero favorable excursion, and lost the 9-EMA ($8.89), which is more than one 5-min ATR of downside against the thesis. With SMR still in a heavy intraday downtrend and sitting only ~0.4% off the day's low, a fresh short offers poor location/reward, so reducing to flat is the cleaner action rather than holding a broken setup or flipping.
